name: io.github.ABGEO/georgia-mcp
title: Georgia MCP
description: An MCP server for Georgian public data, read from the organizations that publish it.

environmentVariables.name: GEOMCP_TRANSIT_TTC_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Turns on the Tbilisi Transport Company. Set it to true with the key.

environmentVariables.name: GEOMCP_TRANSIT_TTC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The key of the Tbilisi Transport Company API.

environmentVariables.name: GEOMCP_RATES_TBC_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Turns on the TBC Bank developer API. Set it to true with the key.

environmentVariables.name: GEOMCP_RATES_TBC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The key of the TBC Bank developer API.

environmentVariables.name: GEOMCP_RATES_CREDO_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Turns on Credo Bank. Set it to true with the key.

environmentVariables.name: GEOMCP_RATES_CREDO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The key of the Credo Bank API.
